title: Viewer count
description: The viewer count changed. Coalesced: at most one per broadcast per interval, and only on change. Published by both roles — the origin knows the global count, each edge only its own local one. The `data` of a `fi.ioio.gawk.broadcast.viewers` CloudEvent.

viewersGlobal.description: Viewers across the fleet, as the origin computes it from the edge leases. An edge reports what it last learned from the origin.
